edits.diagnosis: The preceding paragraph already identifies the default configuration files. This sentence repeats that information while introducing an unclear singular “It.”
edits.quote: It sets all of the default configuration to run Nushell.
edits.reader_benefit: Readers can proceed to customization without resolving an ambiguous reference or rereading the description of the defaults.
edits.retained_meaning: The preceding paragraph retains where the default configuration files are found and when users receive them.

edits.diagnosis: Describing both a series of steps and a series of commands suggests two layers where the sentence defines just one pipeline.
edits.quote: through a series of steps, in a series of commands
edits.reader_benefit: Makes the relationship between commands and a pipeline unambiguous.
edits.retained_meaning: Values pass through a sequence of commands called a pipeline.

edits.diagnosis: The sentence states the absence of mutation twice and delays the concrete pipeline operations with “act as a means to.”
edits.quote: Rather than using mutation, pipelines act as a means to load, change, and save data without mutable state.
edits.reader_benefit: Connects the functional-data goal directly to pipeline operations while stating the constraint once.
edits.replacement: Pipelines load, change, and save data without mutable state.
edits.retained_meaning: Pipelines perform all three named operations without mutable state.
